zoe: FYI alert - mTLS verify errors rising in multi-region (eu-west + ap-south) since 2026-06-01T08:14Z. Errors: 'short certificate chain' and 'verify: missing intermediate'. Anyone triaging?
harry: I see it in proxy logs. Rotator reports 'issued' events but KMS audit shows UnwrapDenied for `serviceAccount:rotator-eu@redwood.iam` and `serviceAccount:rotator-ap@redwood.iam` at ~08:13Z.
leila: Correlating infra changes - a recent policy tighten added an IAM condition on CA keys that requires `request.auth.aud == "infra-agent"`. Rotator's agent identity changed after the infra migration so its requests didn't match the condition.
zoe: That would block unwraps. Quick fixes: 1) add a temporary exception for the rotator principals, 2) restart rotator to force re-unwrap/push, 3) restart edge proxies to evict stale cert caches. Who can apply the exception?
harry: I'll apply exception via console and document it. Doing now. kms-bot: Temporary exception applied for rotator principals in eu-west & ap-south by harry at 2026-06-01T08:17Z (ttl=15m).
leila: Exception visible in KMS audit. Restarting rotator in both regions: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/rotator --region=eu-west,ap-south`. rotator-bot: Restart queued for rotator-eu and rotator-ap.
harry: Rotator logs after restart show `unwrap_success` and `chain_pushed` events. Partial recovery: handshake success up from ~68% -> ~90% in 5m.
zoe: Rolling edge proxies now to clear cert caches: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy --region=eu-west` and same for ap-south. ops-bot: Edge-proxy rollouts started.
leila: Handshake failures down to 0.8% after 8m. Root cause: IAM condition on KMS key blocked rotator unwraps because rotator's auth claim changed post-migration. Rotator emitted 'issued' before unwrap confirm, so proxies briefly served incomplete chains. Secondary: some legacy proxies had long cert-cache TTL which prolonged visible failures.
zoe: Action items: - Add TF pre-apply lint to flag IAM conditions on CA keys that reference ephemeral claims (e.g., request.auth.*) and require manual approval. - Change rotator to mark issuance as pending until unwrap_confirmed or to emit an `issuance_pending` metric. - Add alert: KMS UnwrapDenied spike or issuance_without_unwrap_confirmed -> page security-oncall. - Reduce cert-cache TTL during rotations (default 5m) and document proxies that need shorter TTLs. - Surface TF change id next to KMS audit entries in the console to speed triage.
harry: Also recommend making IAM exceptions timeboxed and logged centrally (we did that here). Filed SEC-72001: "IAM condition blocked KMS unwrap for rotator -> partial mTLS chains served (eu-west/ap-south)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-72001
leila: Will follow up with infra to review safe patterns for conditional IAM and update runbook. Closing unless regressions show up. :thumbsup:
